# Field boundaries for Schleswig-Holstein (SH), Germany

Germany, Schleswig-Holstein field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Land Schleswig-Holstein. License: DL-DE-ZERO-2.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sh/latest/de_sh.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sh/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4647; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: flik, hbn, id, geometry, collection, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sh/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sh/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sh/collection.json
